name: UnARJ
notes: Ronny Schulz's .030 executable was compiled for 68030 and matches stock. The unqualified 68000 build and earlier Amiga port differ.
The installed document is Robert K. Jung's original 2.41 manual. The Amiga extension supports pattern matching and destination paths.
This BCWB command modification displays Unix-host dates in UTC and restores representable Unix member dates on extraction. Other host IDs retain the original date handling.
